Pharmacokinetics Trichloroethane is absorbed after inhalation and ingestion, and through intact skin. Small amounts are metabolised to trichlo- roethanol and trichloroacetic acid and excreted in the urine, but it is largely excreted unchanged through the lungs over a period of days. Uses Trichloroethane has wide applications as an industrial solvent. It is commonly used in dry cleaning, typewriter correction fluids, and as a solvent for plaster removal.
